topic: The sequel so bad it was legally erased from existence by court order
hook: This sequel was so bad, a court ordered it erased from existence.
script: This sequel was so bad, a court ordered it erased from existence. The film sequel to the cult classic Highlander 2 was so poorly received that the original director took legal action to have his name removed from the film entirely. A fan group purchased the rights and re-edited the film into a completely different cut. The studio version was ruled to have violated the director's creative contract. Two versions of the same film with different legal standing. Follow for films so catastrophic they entered legal history.
